svg.title: One changed backend in a 200-VM fleet
svg.desc: A public request reaches one of 190 Windows VMs across 19 pools of 10. At the first canary check, a filled square represents the one backend serving the new link after the script reported failure. The other 189 backends, shown as circles, still serve the old link. The 10 staff VMs are on a separate endpoint and receive no public traffic.
svg.text: One changed backend in a 200-VM fleet
At the first canary check, the link a customer sees depends on which VM serves the request.
Routes each request to one healthy backend
Read pools from left to right. Each symbol is one VM with its own local configuration.
1 canary: serves the new link after a failed command
4. Outside the public path: 10 staff VMs use a separate endpoint.
